Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Japanese woman — the personification of Kyoto — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one square 1:1 image, 1024×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Kyoto as her world knows it — a capital of an eastern myth-world: dark polished wood and fine wooden lattices, pale cypress and grey roof tiles, silk painted in soft flowing colours, paper lanterns and drifting spirit lights, maple leaves and blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the mountains, the river or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a university festival lane of booths under bunting and paper lanterns, a stall counter with hand-drawn signs without readable text and a small stage beyond
Season: high summer in the basin — hot and humid, the latter half of the season hot and sunny after the rains.
Time of day: dawn — the first pale light before the city wakes, the last lamps still lit and the streets quiet; a pale lilac sky, mist low on the ground.
Outfit: decora — a pastel tutu skirt, layered bright tops and stacks of colourful clips and bracelets; styled with supple matte leather and a soft beret tilted to one side, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: seated, leaning slightly forward toward the table, forearms near its edge.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the left of the frame, so her own left side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her far arm, on the side away from the camera; one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side; one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
PROP: with both hands she ties the ribbon of a painted silk balloon on a long ribbon around her wrist — her own right hand loops the ribbon, her own left hand holds out her wrist.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: level brow, calm unhurried eyes, mouth closed and composed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a long dyer's brush of pale bamboo — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.
